s_nail_append.description: Append rather than prepend when writing to mbox.

s_nail_crt.description: Assume a CRT-like terminal and invoke $PAGER if output does not fit.

s_nail_editheaders.description: Allow editing of headers when spawning an editor.

s_nail_emptystart.description: Startup into interactive mode even if mailbox is empty.

s_nail_fullnames.description: Do not strip name parts and comments from receiver addresses.

s_nail_history_gabby.description: Add more entries to the history.

s_nail_hold.description: Do not move read messages of system mailboxes to MBOX.

s_nail_indentprefix.description: Quote the original message in replies.

s_nail_markanswered.description: Mark messages that have been answered.

s_nail_mime_counter_evidence.description: Circumvent false or missing MIME Content-Type descriptions.

s_nail_keep.description: Do not remove empty (MBOX) system mailboxes.

s_nail_keepsave.description: Do not move save'd or write'n message to $MBOX.

s_nail_quote.description: Automatically quote the text of the message that is responded to.

s_nail_recipients_in_cc.description: Do not merge From: and To: of original message into To:.

s_nail_showname.description: Display real sender names in header summaries.

s_nail_showto.description: Show recipients of messages sent by the user himself.

s_nail_retain_headers.default: retain date sender from to cc subject message-id mail-followup-to reply-to
s_nail_retain_headers.description: Selected header fields to retain when printing.
